typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFilename as string (),
	tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsCancelledandNewStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		event_date as string,
		deal_tracking_num as string,
		toolset as string,
		ins_type as string,
		name as string,
		short_name as string,
		internal_external as string,
		type_of_event as string,
		trade_time as string,
		trader_name as string,
		executed_by as string,
		marketer_name as string,
		trade_event_category as string,
		action_interval_days as string,
		booked_to_new_by as string,
		new_validated_by as string,
		tran_num as string,
		sql_date as string,
		latest_validated_by as string,
		amend_reason as string,
		CancelAndNew_by as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> UpdateCancelledandNew
UpdateCancelledandNew derive(FileName = toString($sFilename),
		LoadDate_drv = toString(currentTimestamp()),
		amend_reason_der = toString(replace(amend_reason, toString('\"'), toString('')))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of deal_tracking_num} = deal_tracking_num,
		{Copy of trader_name} = trader_name) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		toolset as string,
		Action_Interval_Days as integer,
		Internal_External as string,
		Trade_Time as string,
		FileName as string,
		Date_Updated as string,
		amend_reason as string,
		Executed_By as string,
		Marketer_Name as string,
		Booked_to_New_By as string,
		CancelAndNew_by as string,
		Name as string,
		Deal_Tracking_Num as string,
		Latest_Validated_By as string,
		Type_of_Event as string,
		insType as string,
		New_Validated_By as string,
		Short_Name as string,
		Event_Date as string,
		Trade_Event_Category as string,
		Trader_Name as string,
		tran_num as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		toolset,
		Action_Interval_Days = action_interval_days,
		Internal_External = internal_external,
		Trade_Time = trade_time,
		FileName,
		Date_Updated = LoadDate_drv,
		amend_reason = amend_reason_der,
		Executed_By = executed_by,
		Marketer_Name = marketer_name,
		Booked_to_New_By = booked_to_new_by,
		CancelAndNew_by,
		Name = name,
		Deal_Tracking_Num = deal_tracking_num,
		Latest_Validated_By = latest_validated_by,
		Type_of_Event = type_of_event,
		insType = ins_type,
		New_Validated_By = new_validated_by,
		Short_Name = short_name,
		Event_Date = event_date,
		Trade_Event_Category = trade_event_category,
		Trader_Name = trader_name,
		tran_num),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsCancelledandNewStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsCancelledandNewStaging
